rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for writing your signature, including on a document or dotted line.

example.english: Please sign this form at the bottom.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 biu2 nei5 cim1 meng2 hai2 haa6 min6

rows.note: Use 牌 as the all-purpose noun for a physical sign or board displaying words or pictures.

example.english: The sign at the entrance says we are closed today.
example.traditional: 門口個牌寫住今日休息。
example.jyutping: mun4 hau2 go3 paai4 se2 zyu6 gam1 jat6 jau1 sik1

rows.note: Use 跡象 for an observable indication that something exists or may happen, rather than for a physical signboard.

example.english: This muggy weather is a sign that it is going to rain.
example.traditional: 天氣咁焗，係落雨嘅跡象。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 gam3 guk6 hai6 lok6 jyu5 ge3 zik1 zoeng6

rows.note: Use 符號 for a symbol or mark representing something, such as a musical or mathematical sign.

example.english: The plus sign is a common symbol in maths.
example.traditional: 加號係數學入面好常見嘅符號。
example.jyutping: gaa1 hou6 hai6 sou3 hok6 jap6 min6 hou2 soeng4 gin3 ge3 fu4 hou6

rows.note: Use this when you mean communicating by means of sign language.

example.english: They usually use sign language to communicate.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ping4 si4 jung6 sau2 jyu5 kau1 tung1

rows.note: Use this for signing a contractual deal, with a team or record label, or engaging a player or performer under contract.

example.english: The team is finally going to sign him.
example.traditional: 支球隊終於要同佢簽約喇。
example.jyutping: zi1 kau4 deoi6 zung1 jyu1 jiu3 tung4 keoi5 cim1 joek3 laa3

rows.note: Use 手語 when sign means the language communicated with hand movements and gestures.

example.english: They use sign language to communicate.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 sau2 jyu5 gau1 tung1

rows.note: Use this formal verb when officially executing or ratifying a document rather than merely writing a signature.

example.english: We formally sign this agreement today.
example.traditional: 我哋今日正式簽署呢份協議。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 zing3 sik1 cim1 cyu5 ni1 fan6 hip3 ji5
